model.title: A resolution expressing support for the designation of September 2026 as "Sickle Cell Disease Awareness Month" in order to educate communities across the United States about sickle cell disease and the need for research, early detection methods, effective treatments, and preventative care programs with respect to complications from sickle cell disease and conditions related to sickle cell disease.

summary.text: The resolution would designate September 2026 as "Sickle Cell Disease Awareness Month" to help educate Americans about sickle cell disease and promote awareness of the importance of research, early detection, effective treatments, and preventative care programs for managing the disease and related conditions.
